_comment: Every balance constant and every fixed 3D convention in the game. No magic numbers in .gd files, ever — see CLAUDE.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE_GUIDE.md §6. Values are addressed by dotted path: Tuning.get_num("camera.pitch_deg"). All lengths are metres, because 1 unit = 1 metre.

world._comment: The conventions table in docs/ARCHITECTURE_GUIDE.md §4. Changing any of these later means remaking every asset, so they are recorded here once and read from here everywhere. latitude_deg is the dale's latitude: it drives the daylight swing that is the core mechanic (docs/SIMULATION_SPEC.md §2.2), so it belongs with the conventions and not with tunable feel.

time._comment: The authoritative clock, docs/SIMULATION_SPEC.md §2.1. minutes_per_day, days_per_year and the month lengths are calendar facts, not feel. real_seconds_per_day and the speed multipliers are feel and can be tuned freely. Leap years are ignored on purpose (placeholder). start_day_of_week is 0=Sunday; the founding is placed in mid-March, the season a house was actually founded in.

sky._comment: Solar geometry and the day/night light rig. axial_tilt_deg is an astronomical constant (Earth's obliquity) and drives declination in scripts/sim/daylight.gd, which then gives the real altitude and bearing of the sun for any minute of any day. solar_noon_minute fixes local noon (the model ignores the equation of time). twilight_band_deg is how far below the horizon the sun still lights the sky; night_light_energy is the residual moonlight the directional light keeps once the sun is fully down. Sun colour, sky tint and fog keyframes by sun altitude live in data/sky.json.

seasons._comment: Phase 2.4 season blend. day-of-year keyframes in data/seasons.json are lerped by scripts/sim/season_curve.gd. snow_line_lapse_m is how much the winter snow line drops per unit of season snow_coverage; it is feel. transition_days softens the four keyframes into ramps rather than steps.

weather._comment: Phase 2.7 daily weather. Authoritative and deterministic from an injected Dice (docs/ARCHITECTURE_GUIDE.md §7). Seasonal mean temperature in °C and daily precipitation probability are lerped from the same season curve; day-to-day variation is bounded noise, then a 3-day trailing smooth. freeze_point_c gates frost; hard_frost_c gates the construction frost gate later.

camera._comment: The orthographic rig, docs/ARCHITECTURE_GUIDE.md §4. Pitch, yaw step and the ortho range are conventions rather than taste — the rest is feel and can be tuned freely. distance_m is the exception: because the projection is orthographic it has no effect on apparent size, but volumetric fog and the shadow range are both measured from the camera, so a distant camera drowns the whole scene in fog and pushes it past directional_shadow_max_distance. Keep it just large enough to clear the geometry at the widest zoom.
